say:1:1230812001:1.text: Of course, but... it was too sudden!
say:1:1230812001:1.source_cn: 散了当然是好的……可太突然了！

say:2:1230812002:1.text: What I mean is, couldn't it have waited until after I'd charted a safe route through it?
say:2:1230812002:1.source_cn: 我的意思是，等我开辟出安全的航路，再消散也不迟。

say:3:1230812003:1.text: I would've been the most famous helmsman in Rustport!
say:3:1230812003:1.source_cn: 这样，我就会成为锈锚港最具有传奇色彩的舵手！

say:4:1230812004:1.text: Now, everywhere you go, people only talk about Merlin and that kid named Sinbad... They're just luckier than me!
say:4:1230812004:1.source_cn: 现在可好，大街小巷都说着梅林，还有那个叫辛巴达的小子…...
say:4:1230812004:1.male: Now, everywhere you go, people only talk about Merlin and that kid named Sinbad... They're just luckier than me!
say:4:1230812004:1.female: Now, everywhere you go, people only talk about Merlin and that kid named Sinbad... They're just luckier than me!
